manifest.title: Langfuse
manifest.tagline: Open-source LLM observability: tracing, evals, prompt management
manifest.description:
This is an **unofficial community package**, not affiliated with or supported by Langfuse GmbH.

Langfuse is an open-source LLM engineering platform: trace and debug LLM applications and agents,
run evaluations, manage and version prompts, build datasets and track cost, latency and quality.
It works with the Langfuse SDKs (Python, JS/TS), OpenTelemetry and integrations such as LangChain,
LlamaIndex, the OpenAI SDK and LiteLLM.

### This package

* Langfuse web and worker, with a bundled ClickHouse (traces) and S3 server (raw events, media);
  PostgreSQL, Redis and outgoing email provided by Cloudron.
* Sign-in with Cloudron accounts, another OpenID Connect provider, or email and password;
  sign-up is closed by default.
* Cloudron backups and restore cover all of it, ClickHouse included.
manifest.postInstallMessage:
**With Cloudron user management:** sign in with your Cloudron account. The first person to sign in
creates the first organization; others see only what they are invited to (and may create their own).

**Without it:** open the **File Manager**, set your email as `LANGFUSE_INIT_USER_EMAIL` in
`/app/data/env.sh` and **restart** the app. Your password is in the **Web Terminal**:
`grep INITIAL_ADMIN /app/data/.secrets/secrets.env`. Sign-up is closed to everyone else.

Then create a project and its API keys, and point your SDKs at `https://$CLOUDRON-APP-DOMAIN`.

LANGFUSE_MEDIA_DOMAIN.title: Media storage
LANGFUSE_MEDIA_DOMAIN.description: S3 endpoint for multimodal trace attachments (images, audio, files), used by SDKs and browsers through presigned links. Requests need a valid signature; the bucket is private.
